verdict.rationale: Undermind documents one narrow form of event-triggered automation. Users can save topics and get notified when relevant papers are published, and Enterprise adds role-aware alerts that monitor saved topics and send tailored updates. There is no evidence of a general rules engine where users define conditions and choose which actions fire. missing for 10: user-defined rule/condition configuration, configurable actions beyond notifications (e.g., auto-run reviews, add to folders, call webhooks), event types beyond new publications, detailed docs and independent corroboration of the alerting feature.
